content.comment_body: Hello, do I need a [product_name] [article_no] to expand my [product_name] [article_no]? Or is [version_no] only compatible with the [article_no] expansion module? Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. The [product_name] [article_no] is only compatible with the [version_no] series. You need the [product_name] [article_no] instead.
I see, thank you. Does this also apply to [version_no]? Is the [article_no] compatible with it, or only with [version_no]?
Please refer to the [company_name] FAQ for a compatibility overview of [product_name] modules.
Response from the link above: Did you mean: [url]? If so, everything is clear now.
Yes, that's the one I meant.
Will a [article_no] digital expansion module work with a [article_no]?

Did you read the previous posts? Your [product_name] ([article_no]) is a [version_no] [product_name]. Expansion modules compatible with the [product_name] [version_no] have [article_no] at the end of the article number. Expansion modules ending with [article_no] do not work with a [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: Users are uncertain about which [product_name] versions and expansion modules are compatible, especially with regard to matching article numbers and hardware generations. The main concern is distinguishing compatibility criteria and making the right purchase decisions.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward information that helps them determine which expansion modules are compatible with each version of the [product_name], aiming to avoid buying hardware that won't work.
